name: intellij-plugin-engineering
description: IntelliJ Platform plugin delivery guidance for descriptors, lifecycle, threading, PSI and indexes, Starter/Driver UI tests, Plugin Verifier, packaging, and dynamic unload.

metadata.dailyDriver: Install through intellij-plugin-default when a repository needs the full Kotlin, Gradle, Git, CI, and IntelliJ development flow.
metadata.notFor: End-user IDE configuration, greenfield scaffolding, generic Kotlin repositories without IntelliJ plugin code, copied SDK documentation, or bypassing repository-owned release and runtime authority.
metadata.packageBoundary: This plugin owns only IntelliJ-specific delivery decisions. Kotlin, Gradle, TDD, Git, PR, and CI capabilities are composed by intellij-plugin-default.
metadata.scope: IntelliJ Platform plugin delivery: descriptors, dependencies, lifecycle, threading, PSI/indexing, Gradle Plugin 2.x, Starter/Driver UI automation, verification, packaging, and dynamic unload.
